This will permanently delete every preset and cannot be undone.
This mode disables all throttling and may cause system instability or freezes with screen capture animations.
RAGNAROK sends LED commands as fast as possible and can overwhelm your device. Use only if you understand the risks.
This app is currently in beta and may cause crashes or unstable behavior.
DuoFrost is free software. Source code and releases are available at https://github.com/Tufein/DuoFrost.

Animations now switch automatically based on the foreground app.
In this mode, swiping presets will not change the running animation. Assign apps to presets in settings to control what plays automatically.
Allows the app to send LED animations and presets to DuoFrost.
DuoFrost uses Accessibility screenshot capture to sample your screen continuously without repeating capture prompts.
Allows DuoFrost to capture display frames for LED ambient effects.
Needed for App Profile mode so DuoFrost can detect foreground apps and auto-switch presets.
You can now start DuoFrost and keep it running in background until you press Stop or Kill.
A crash report was saved on this device
Sending it helps fix the problem. Nothing is sent automatically, and the report contains only the error, your Android version and your device model.
One small network request at launch
DuoFrost can check the plugin store for updates each time it starts.\n\nThis is off by default. You can change it anytime in the Plugin Store.
Ambient and AmbiAurora will look less fluid

Accessibility capture never asks for permission again, but it samples the screen more slowly, so Ambient and AmbiAurora animations lose smoothness.\n\nScreen capture stays fluid and is the default. It asks for permission once per launch.
Allows DuoFrost to capture display frames for LED effects.

Use the Battery Saver limit below while Android Battery Saver is on.
A ceiling for every effect and app profile. Lower limits never brighten an already dim color. 0% keeps the service running with LEDs off.
Apply the screen-off limit when Android puts the device to sleep. Wake restores normal output. Thor lid behavior depends on its system settings.
DuoFrost was added to Quick Settings. Use the tile to switch lighting on or off.

Open Quick Settings, tap Edit and add the DuoFrost tile.
Keep lighting active after closing recent apps, and let Android restore it after a process interruption. Stop still turns it off.
Start lighting when opening DuoFrost or turning on the device. Screen and audio capture may need fresh permission.

Allow background lighting to reduce battery restrictions. In app settings, allow background battery use if your device offers it. Some firmware still stops apps with Clear all; lock DuoFrost in Recents if that option is available. Android Force stop requires opening the app again. After a restart, screen or audio capture needs fresh permission.
Open Android Settings → Apps → DuoFrost to allow background battery use.
